description: For a hard-to-park New Orleans destination (French Quarter, CBD, Superdome, Convention Center), suggest where to park outside the busy area and ride the streetcar in: the boarding stop, which line, the next scheduled departures, ride time, and the walk at the end. Returns nothing when parking at the destination is easy enough that park-and-ride doesn't make sense.

address.description: Destination address or landmark in New Orleans.

name: park_and_ride
title: Park and ride the New Orleans streetcar
